correctness.rationale: In S(K_n), n>=3, checking shortest-path predecessor uniqueness gives each original probe both halfedges at its index, and each subdivision probe the halfedges at its two indices. This yields the exact criterion U∪V(F)=[n] OR |U|>=n-1 (note the alternative is essential). Inclusion-exclusion over uncovered original labels proves every term of D_n(x,y); requiring indispensability yields disjoint unions of stars covering [n]\U plus the n all-but-one-original exceptions. The labeled exponential formula M_n = n![t^n]exp(xt+yt^2/2+t(e^(yt)-1-yt))-x^n+nx^(n-1) follows because two-vertex stars are unoriented. Counts and n=3 exceptional minimum follow by matching/star cases. Independent BFS edge-deletion enumeration agrees for n=3,4: 51 and 841 monitoring sets, 9 and 29 minimal sets, minimum multiplicities 9 and 3. These finite cases corroborate but do not establish universal quantification.
residual_risks: n>=3, exactly one subdivision of each clique edge; unweighted and single edge deletion; no claim for arbitrary subdivisions.
